in_sanskrit.name: अथरथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who remains constant, unchanging, steadfast, and unwavering.

in_hindi.name: अथरथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: अथर (athar) means unchanging, steadfast, and eternal. अथरथ (atharath) could be derived from this, meaning one who embodies these qualities.

in_tamil.name: அதர்த்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who possesses great strength, power, and firmness.

in_telugu.name: ఆథార్థ
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who remains constant, unchanging, and eternal.

in_marathi.name: Atharth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atharth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Atharth is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'atharva'. It is considered a masculine name and is associated with the deity Atharva, who is one of the Adityas and is known as the 'Lord of the Gods'. In Hindu mythology, Atharva is believed to possess immense power and wisdom, and is often invoked for prosperity, protection, and success.
